verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a Git forge that ships a CLI and web app. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting or environment variable for the Cafe CLI or the web service. The CLI flags documented (`--json`, `--no-input`, `--yes`) and the MCP repository-access scoping are unrelated controls and earn no credit.
